question:
**Select the most appropriate option to substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence. If there is no need to substitute it, select 'No substitution required'.**

Girish was able to drive down from Bengaluru in ten hours __as there was very little__ traffic on the highway.

options.text: as there was a very little

solution:
The correct sentence is "**No substitution required**"
